title: GeomTorch: Geometric Deep Learning & Lie Group Equivariance in PyTorch
subtitle: Open-Source Research Framework
description: An open-source PyTorch library providing clean implementations of SO(3), SE(3), and Lorentz-equivariant convolution layers, Clebsch-Gordan tensor products, and Clifford algebra layers. Starred by over 1,400 researchers worldwide.

title: SympFlow: Symplectic Continuous Normalizing Flows for Hamiltonian Physics
subtitle: Physics-Informed Simulation Tool
description: High-performance Python/JAX package for long-horizon symplectic integration using neural differential equations. Guarantees conservation of phase-space volume and total energy invariants in mechanical systems.

title: SpectralPDE-Bench: Benchmark Suite for Neural Operators on Non-Trivial Topologies
subtitle: Benchmark & Dataset
description: A standardized benchmark dataset comprising 50,000 high-fidelity simulations of Navier-Stokes and Maxwell equations across complex toroidal, spherical, and manifold meshes.
